The scatter plot above shows the relationship between the number of absences in a month and the size of a class. What is the size of the class that had $7$ absences in the month?
feedback.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/a41ff9a7f77a393b6575ee21525de15517038188afeca0b7783d175c3f4c34b1.png)

To determine the size of the class that had $7$ absences in a month, we locate $7$ on the vertical axis and move in the horizontal direction until we find some points, as shown above. 

The highlighted point has coordinates $(16,7).$ Therefore, the class that had $7$ absences in the month has $16$ students.
